7.source_text: Wo feel thankful unto thee, our. Father, that thou hast revealed thy will in this our day, that thou hast spoken from the heavens, and bestowed the holy Priesthood upon men, and again opened up the way of life and salvation, and that we aro the happy partakers thereof.

Truly happy is that man or woman, or that people, who enjoys the
privileges of the Gospel of the Son of God, and who know how to
appreciate his blessings. 1:309.
